Detailed Itinerary Of the Tour

  • 08:00 AM: Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel, Airbnb, homestay, or residence and transfer you to our office or bicycle store, where you can choose the most suitable bicycle for your ride. The adventure begins as we cycle through the French Quarter, admiring the beautiful French architecture.

  • Our first stop will be St. Joseph’s Cathedral, one of the oldest churches in Hanoi. You will have time to explore and learn about its history while taking pictures.

  • We then continue cycling through the Old Quarter, passing narrow roads and alleys, to reach the Railway Train Track. Here, you will cycle along the tracks, observing the houses built next to the railway, offering a glimpse into the daily lives of locals living close to the train line.

  • On this short tour of Hanoi, we will visit key landmarks such as Le Nin Park and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. You will stop outside the mausoleum to take pictures and learn about the history of Vietnam’s beloved leader.

  • We will cycle along Thanh Nien Road, passing West Lake and Truc Bach Lake, two of Hanoi’s most beautiful lakes. You will also visit the John McCain Monument before heading to Tran Quoc Pagoda, one of the oldest pagodas in Hanoi.

  • Next, we will cycle through a small alley to visit a local market, where you will see fresh food sold by vendors and get an insight into the daily life of the locals. You will also have the chance to sample some tropical fruits.

  • Continuing along the Red River Island, we will explore the countryside, cycling past banana farms and corn farms along the riverside. We will then visit the Floating Village and meet a local family to learn about their life on the island.

  • We will cycle along the riverbank to visit the Long Bien Bridge, a historic structure built by the French during the colonial era (1898-1902). From the bridge, you will enjoy a panoramic view of the city, the river, and the surrounding countryside, all while learning about the historical significance of this iconic bridge.

  • After a full day of exploration, we will return to your hotel, marking the end of your tour.

Tour Includes:

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Quality mountain bike provided

  • All entry fees + free water during the tour

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • For groups of 3 or more people, a support guide will accompany the group to ensure safety and security during the tour.
outline: Day 1: Visit Hanoi And Countryside By Bicycle
